verdict.rationale: Lever's Automation Hub and Advanced Nurture features automate routine, recurring tasks like tagging, archiving, emailing, and candidate re-engagement, suggesting some recurring workflow automation, but there is no documentation of a scheduler, cron-like job configuration, or API/webhook mechanism for AI-native users to define and schedule custom recurring workflows. missing for 10: explicit scheduling API/UI for recurring jobs, third-party or hands-on verification, granularity/control over schedule cadence.
